text: とても　きれいに　みがかれた　まど　だ！

structure.jp: とても　きれいに　みがかれた

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The れる ending says the thing had the action done to it. みがかれた = 'was polished'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: とても　きれいに　みがかれた　まど
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, put before a thing, describes that thing. きれいに　みがかれた　まど = 'a window that has been polished clean'.
